text: ITEM 1 | Brown oval nuts, smooth-to-slightly-ridged skin, tan to medium-brown with some darker speckles, dry matte surface with no sheen or moisture, pointed ends, each about 2.5-3 cm long and 1.5-2 cm wide, scattered in a loose cluster across the center and right side of a white square plate about 20 cm across; roughly 20 pieces, some whole and a few with a cracked or split shell edge, covering about 35% of the plate surface, mostly 1 cm tall | 40
